sources.snippet: Incomplete submittals WILL NOT be accepted. Make sure the application is complete and you provide all the required plans and construction documents. Complete submittals will prevent unnecessary delays in the plan review process. Make sure the site plan is complete. The purpose of the site plan is to clearly show the entire lot and existing home, proposed project, all buildings, sheds, and accessory structures, proposed setbacks dimensions, public utility easements. Plan must be to scale.
